newsitem.title: UK: Hard Rock,Time Warner venture seen - report.
newsitem.headline: Hard Rock,Time Warner venture seen - report.

text.p: Rank Organisation Plc's Hard Rock Cafe chain may move into the music business through a joint venture with Time Warner Inc's Rhino Records, the Sunday Times newspaper reported.
The report said the link with the U.S. entertainment group could be unveiled this week when Rank chief executive Andrew Teare gives investors a trading update.
The briefing will also likely include a report on Rank's sale of its Shearing holiday arm to a management team backed by NatWest Ventures, the paper said.
The first product of the joint venture will probably come out in the spring, when Hard Rock releases its first CD, a compilation from Rhino's archives, the report said.
Rank was not immediately available for comment.
